description: Search PBGC's register of single-employer pension plans PBGC has trusteed — i.e. taken over as trustee because the plan terminated underfunded. Returns case number, sponsor, plan name, EIN, termination date, date PBGC became trustee, and participant count at termination. Answers "pension plans PBGC has taken over in Illinois", "list trusteed plans for United Airlines", "biggest PBGC trusteeships by participants". Example: pbgc_search_trusteed_plans({ sponsor: "United Airlines" }); pbgc_search_trusteed_plans({ state: "IL", limit: 25 }). Keyless.

state.description: Two-letter US state code of the sponsor

name: pbgc_search_trusteed_plans
title: Pbgc Search Trusteed Plans
